ideas.pitch: A CLI and execution visualizer specifically designed to teach and test complex SQL query optimization and Java multithreading bottlenecks for online assessment candidates.
ideas.title: JavaDBSMOptimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the core evaluation pillars of Java programming, DBMS fundamentals, and DSA explicitly aligns with the judge's focus on technical core competencies.

ideas.pitch: An in-memory bytecode execution visualizer that steps through hidden test cases for Java DSA problems, mapping out memory allocation and stack traces in real time.
ideas.title: AlgoTraceJava
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the assessment's emphasis on algorithmic efficiency, hidden test cases, and strict time constraints.

ideas.title: DBMSConstraintGuardian
